encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

lg.l: ἔμμητρον ἂν ᾖ τὸ ξύλον, βλάστην ἔχει.
Μητρᾶς ὁ Χῖός ἐστι τῷ δήμῳ φίλος.

note.p: Athenaeus 3, 100 d μνημονεύει τῆς μήτρας καὶ Ἀντιφάνης ἐν Φιλομήτορι οὕτως κτλ.

1. ἔνμητρον ἐὰν A. 2. in exitu πόλις add. Mein. 4. Μητρᾶς (i. e. Μητρόδωρος) Mein.] μήτρας. Theophr. H. pl. 1, 6, 5 ἅπασαι δ' (αἱ ῥίζαι) ἔμμητροι. Caus. pl. 5, 17, 2 τὰ ξύλα τὰ ἔμμητρα διαστρέφεται κατειργασμένα ἤδη μέχρι οὗ ἂν τελέως ἀναξηρανθῇ. 2. Μητρόπολις et Πατρόπολις Meinekius. at non opus est nomine proprio: siquidem is qui loquitur matri plus quam patri verecundiae deberi comice exemplis demonstrat. sic μητρόπολιν urbem dici ex qua coloniae deducantur, non πατρόπολιν. 4. 'Metrodorum Chium, Anaxarchi Abderitae Ol. 110 clari magistrum commemorat Diog. L. 9, 58.' Mein. Μητρόδωρος ὁ Χῖος ἐν Τρωικοῖς Athen. 4, 184a. περὶ φύσεως Cic. Acad. 2, 23, 73.
